scope: original concept art only; no game integration or repository push

traits.name: Fernfrond
traits.biological_basis: Fern-leaf morphology, interpreted as a separate Bagseed variant
traits.evidence: Game name; shared real-world morphology with Freakshow
traits.research_note: No independently established Fernfrond mutation was verified. Use the fern-leaf family as its visual basis.
traits.art_direction: Proposed distinction: long, delicate fronds with evenly spaced fine lateral lobes. Open, airy foliage; retain a readable central axis on each leaf.
traits.avoid: Do not reuse the exact Freakshow sprite or present the proposed distinction as a separate proven genotype.
traits.stage_notes: Young: early divided leaves. Vegetative: fine frond silhouette. Flowering: recognizable fronds remain beside normal cannabis inflorescences.

traits.name: Goldleaf
traits.biological_basis: Yellow-green pigment variation; Divina visual analogue
traits.evidence: Game name; real yellow-green variegation documented in a plant patent
traits.research_note: Divina documents yellow-green foliage. This does not verify an entirely golden Bagseed phenotype.
traits.art_direction: Use chartreuse, yellow-green and muted ochre highlights, with darker green veins for legibility. Treat uniform gold as an intentional art exaggeration.
traits.avoid: Using necrotic brown margins or drooping deficiency leaves as the default healthy mutation. Metallic gold reflections.
traits.stage_notes: Young: pale lime leaves. Vegetative: strongest yellow-green surfaces. Flowering: keep recognizable live foliage rather than a dead autumn silhouette.

traits.name: Ember Stem
traits.evidence: Game name; photographed cannabis pigmentation research
traits.research_note: Cannabis petioles and veins can accumulate red-purple anthocyanin pigmentation; redness alone is not proof of mutation.
traits.art_direction: Concentrate muted red, burgundy or rose color on stems, petioles and selected veins. Retain green leaves for a strong contrast.
traits.avoid: Flat neon-red paint over every branch. Presenting redness as a diagnosis of genetics, nutrition or health.
traits.stage_notes: Young: red petiole accents. Vegetative: more visible colored stems. Flowering: continue the same tissue-specific color placement.

traits.name: Pink Pistil
traits.biological_basis: Pink stigmas, commonly called pistils by growers
traits.evidence: Documented cultivar color trait; Serious Seeds reference
traits.research_note: Serious 6 includes plants with pink flower stigmas. This is a floral color trait, not proof of a new mutation.
traits.art_direction: Paint thin curling pink and magenta hairs emerging from green flower clusters. Use white or pale pink secondary hairs to retain detail.
traits.avoid: Solid pink leaves or large pink flower petals. Pink hairs visible before female flowers develop.
traits.stage_notes: Young/vegetative: ordinary foliage. Early flowering: sparse pink hairs. Mature flowering: denser hair clusters while green bracts remain visible.

traits.name: Inkleaf
traits.evidence: Game name; pigment analogue, not verified literal black mutation
traits.research_note: Dark red-purple cannabis leaf pigmentation provides a visual analogue; the research does not establish literal ink-black leaves.
traits.art_direction: Use a deep purple-green base, plum shadows and cool green edge highlights. Preserve veins and overlapping leaf boundaries.
traits.avoid: Featureless black silhouettes. Assuming darker color establishes potency or a distinct mutation.
traits.stage_notes: Young: restrained purple-green. Vegetative: broaden dark leaf surfaces. Flowering: keep highlights so dark foliage remains readable behind buds.

source_constraints: Reference provenance carried from supplied pack. Originals left unmodified outside repository; no external photographs shipped as assets. R21 is a low-resolution monochrome patent figure, not a color palette source.
color_and_morphology_limits: Fernfrond separation from Freakshow is a proposed game convention; uniform Goldleaf and extreme dark Inkleaf are game pigment interpretations. A/B/C detail studies are proposed art variations, not verified genetic combinations.
whole_plant_notes: One flowering example per trait; identical pot type for comparison, visible branch nodes, dominant top flower and smaller lateral/lower bud sites. Pink Pistil affects stigmas rather than fan leaves.
approval_note: User approved this batch and requested the remaining five. Production integration and push have not occurred.
